description: This file defines the 'DelegatedCommandSender' interface in the 'org.eclipse.hono.client' package. It declares a method for sending command messages to a downstream peer in a messaging system, involving asynchronous operation via Vert.x's Future and tracing with OpenTracing's SpanContext. The interface extends 'MessageSender' and is part of the Eclipse Hono client library, primarily used for delegating command messages within the Hono IoT messaging infrastructure.

methods.name: sendCommandMessage
methods.description: Sends a command message to the downstream peer. Returns a Future indicating success or failure, with optional tracing context.
